# Bun runtime: adopt, migrate from Node, run tests

Curated by Skill Harbor — @affaan-m's Bun runtime playbook: a practical guide for the agent on when to pick Bun over Node (new JS/TS projects, install/run speed, single toolchain) and when to stay on Node (ecosystem compatibility, legacy tooling), with migration notes (bun install, bun run, Bun APIs, bun.lock/bun.lockb) and Vercel deployment specifics (runtime setting, build and frozen-lockfile installs). Includes ready-to-paste run/install/test commands and the built-in Bun.serve and Bun.file APIs. Honest caveat: the migration notes are written against current Bun — lockfile defaults and Bun/Node compat can drift, so re-verify against the Bun docs on a real migration. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
